lens: Aster: honesty surface and maintainer tooling
title: Line Drift
tagline: Check every file:line citation, backticked path and commit hash in STATUS, INVARIANTS, the founding docs and the MCP README against the checkout, and report which have moved, vanished, or point at ignored or untracked evidence.
pitch: The control plane an agent is told to trust first is a set of Markdown files full of `path:line` citations and quoted snippets, and they go stale faster than anyone re-reads them. `node line-drift.mjs <checkout>` extracts, from STATUS.md, INVARIANTS.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, mcp/README.md, the SLICE_*_FOUNDING.md files and strategy/*.md: `path:line[-line]` citations, backticked repo paths, and 7-40 hex commit references. For each it checks that the path exists, is git-tracked (`git ls-files --error-unmatch`) and not ignored (`git check-ignore -v`, the INV-034 test), that the line is inside the file, and, when a backticked snippet or quoted string sits in the same sentence, that the cited line contains it; if not, it searches the file and reports where the snippet lives now. Commits are checked with `git cat-file -e`, with a shallow-clone caveat. It prints a table (OK, MOVED, GONE, MISSING-PATH, IGNORED, UNTRACKED, UNREACHABLE-COMMIT, UNCHECKABLE) with counts per document and never edits anything. At 62ddb17 my spot-check found `src/v2/app/porkchop/main.ts:637` now reads `'a',` (the 'Grid spans' sentence moved to :647), `.githooks/pre-commit:53` is a comment, `mcp/src/tools/compute-shared.ts:139` is `}`, INVARIANTS' `.gitignore:17` points at a comment (the glob is at :19), `src/v2/SLICE_18_FOUNDING.md` cites `tools/slice18-research/tier-sizing-results.json` which is absent, and `src/v2/SLICE_15_FOUNDING.md` cites `src/v2/launch-vehicles.ts` which is absent.
whyNow: Audit Theme 2 `tools/audit/sanity-69472a3/ASTER_AUDIT_REPORT.md:246-275` ('the agent control plane is stale in load-bearing ways') and the convergence table row ':563' ('.gitignore:17 citation is off at HEAD'); INV-033/INV-034 (`INVARIANTS.md:171-182, 207-208`: cited evidence must be tracked, `git check-ignore -v` returns nothing); AGENTS.md §2.1 rule 5 (every path/hash/count confirmed in THIS repo); STATUS.md:417-419 and :535 citing lines that no longer hold the quoted text. Counted at 62ddb17: 16 `file:line` citations in STATUS.md and 32 across INVARIANTS.md and the Slice 15-19 founding docs.
computes: Extraction regexes for citations, backticked paths with a known extension, and hex hashes; sentence segmentation to pair a citation with a nearby quoted snippet or backticked code. Checks: fs.existsSync; line count vs cited line; snippet containment on the cited line(s); fallback full-file search for the snippet (first and all occurrences); git ls-files / check-ignore / cat-file -e via child_process with every failure mapped to UNCHECKABLE, not to OK. Output: JSON and Markdown tables, per-document counts, exit code non-zero on MOVED/GONE/MISSING-PATH/IGNORED unless allowlisted with a reason.
dataNeeded: None snapshotted; the tool reads a live checkout. Tests use a 3-file fixture tree with a `.gitignore` and a fixture Markdown (~3 KB), plus a 300-byte snapshot of STATUS.md:417-419 (sidecar) to pin the extraction regexes on real prose. The README's findings table is generated by `--report` at 62ddb17.
existingOverlap: `tests/v2-about-evidence.test.mjs` pins one commit and one heading anchor for the About page; INV-034 verification is a manual `git check-ignore` command. Nothing scans citations across documents or reports where a snippet moved. The audit did this once by hand in prose.
honestyRisks: A line citation is legitimately pinned to the commit the sentence was written at, so MOVED is reported as 'at HEAD', never as 'wrong'; where the sentence names a commit and it is reachable, the tool verifies against `git show <commit>:<path>` instead. Snippet pairing is heuristic and may miss; unpaired citations get only the in-range check and say so. Counts in the README are produced by the tool, not typed. Shallow clones make commit checks UNCHECKABLE, and the output states the clone depth.
testPlan: Fixture: a doc citing `a.ts:3` with the snippet at :3 is OK; snippet at :5 is MOVED with ':5' reported; snippet absent is GONE; a missing path is MISSING-PATH; a path matched by the fixture .gitignore is IGNORED when git is available and UNCHECKABLE otherwise; a 40-hex string not in the repo is UNREACHABLE-COMMIT. Extraction on the snapshotted STATUS paragraph yields exactly its citations (`main.ts:637`, `:646`, `:187-194`, `:189`) and the quoted 'Grid spans 2026-2040' snippet. Checkout run (skipped if absent): `.gitignore:17` MOVED to :19 for `tools/slice9-research/data/*`; `src/v2/app/porkchop/main.ts:637` with 'Grid spans' MOVED to :647; `src/v2/launch-vehicles.ts` MISSING-PATH.
landing: Aster: `tools/lint/citations.mjs`, run in CI and at session start beside `git log --oneline -1`; its table feeds each STATUS refresh. To ship: agree the status vocabulary and an allowlist for intentionally historical lines (founding docs are additive-only and keep stale sentences with annotations, so the tool must distinguish 'annotated' from 'unannotated' drift).
notes: Verified STATUS.md:418 still cites main.ts:637 for a string now at :647 and that AGENTS tells agents to trust STATUS first. Canonical doc-path/citation checker; W1-04 duplicates its path half.

Verified .gitignore:17 is a comment and the glob is at :19 while INVARIANTS.md:179 cites :17, and main.ts:637 now reads 'a',; reports MOVED at HEAD rather than wrong, which is the right vocabulary for additive-only docs.

Spot-checked: main.ts:637 is now `'a',` with the 'Grid spans' sentence at :647, and docs/assets ships porkchopV2-CeMrUCV7.js not the STATUS-cited z3nhVK2W. Citation-plus-snippet checking is the right discriminator; shallow clones make commit checks UNCHECKABLE, which it says.
